# Camp Resource: Pumpkin Pie Stand

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 12, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e056467a85c942b8b9bc1d08b30b9923~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Pumpkin Pie Stand__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f9a3855c3cc149828a9f393d113b4240~mv2.png)

Image Credit: MsBlobby

*"Gather round for a slice of the pie!"*

__Overview__

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Produces "Slice of Pumpkin Pie"

**Keywords**

- Pastry
- Cake
- Pie
- Birthday Cake

| Item Produced | Drop Rate | Duration | Base Effect | Herbivore Effect | Herbivore + SIN Effect | 
| Slice of Pumpkin Pie | 100% | 1h 30m | +3 CHA | +3 CHA | +3 CHA | 

**Secondary Effects**

| Effect | Value | Duration | Total | 
| Restore Health | 3.6 HP/s | 25 s | 90 HP | 
| Restore Action Points | 12 AP/s | 25 s | 300 AP | 
| Restore Hunger | 1440 pts | Instant | 1440 | 
| Radiation Damage | 2 RAD | Instant | 2 RAD | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: None
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 2x Glass
- 3x Wood

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 2 pounds of Pumpkin Pie Slices

- **__How to Unlock__**
 - Atom Shop: 
 - Pumpkin Pie Stand: 500 Atoms
 - Bountiful Food Bundle: 1300 Atoms (includes Pumpkin Pie Stand)
 - Tradeable: No
 - Giftable: No
 Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
